messages:
maya-docs: Quick flag: the README quickstart has three small drift issues across languages that are confusing new users. Noticed in onboarding session today.

maya-docs: 1) Go snippet imports net/http but uses a Python-style requests call.
2) Ruby sample uses ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'] while JS/Python use REDWOOD_API_KEY.
3) The examples show non-streaming calls but the text implies streaming.

trent-support: saw two tickets where users pasted the Ruby sample into a Rails initializer and accidentally committed an API key to a public repo. Oops.

anya-devex: yikes. Let's do a quick triage: standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, fix the Go snippet to use http.Client, and clarify the streaming vs non-streaming paragraph. I'll open a tiny PR.

rui-sdks: Also: please include a comment in each snippet that says "replace with your own key, do not commit" and link to the security best practices page. For Go and Ruby show minimal examples only; link to full examples for streaming.

maya-docs: draft fix I pushed in branch docs/quickstart-snippet-audit. Changes: Ruby env var -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, Go snippet uses http.NewRequest + client.Do, and a small block explaining streaming vs non-streaming shapes.

maya-docs: sample Go before:

```go
// bad snippet (copy/paste error)
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, strings.NewReader(body))
resp := requests.Post(url, ...)
```

maya-docs: after:

```go
// recommended
req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(body)))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
// handle resp.Body etc.
```

rui-sdks: perfect. Can we also add a CI smoke test that runs the language snippets (using a mock server) so copy/paste drift gets caught? I can add a small runner to examples/ci that starts a mock endpoint and runs tiny commands for ruby/go/py/js.

examples-ci-bot: created job: examples/snippet-smoke (mock-server + snippet runners)  queued.

trent-support: adding a support playbook note to check snippet drift if we see repeated 401/403/500 from new accounts. Helps Triage.

anya-devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/966  fixes snippets, standardizes env var, adds security note, and wires up the smoke test job.

maya-docs: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/966  please sanity check language samples and the security callout.

trent-support: verified Ruby and Go snippets locally; added a small note in the onboarding checklist to remind trainers to run the preview when teaching.

maya-docs: great. Once CI green I'll merge. Also created follow-up ticket to run the snippet-smoke job weekly to proactively detect drift.

rui-sdks: thanks all. This should cut down the common copy/paste mistakes we've been triaging. Closing thread after merge. :sparkles:
